jobs.title: Loss Prevention Teammate - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

Overview

2nd Shift Opportunity

Monday - Thursday

4:00pm-2:30am

$20.05/hr + $1.00/hr shift differential

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Inventory Integrity, shrink control and profit protection.

  • Conduct and assist in internal investigations (theft, dishonesty, policy violations, human resources) in the DC.
  • Conduct and assist with external investigations related to cargo theft to and from the DC’s.
  • Complete daily, weekly, monthly & quarterly audits
  • Conduct lane inspections/ carton scans to improve operational accuracy and document in LPMS / DSGiQ (case management systems)
  • Compile and reconcile data for Seal Verification reporting.
    • Researches, resolves and documents discrepancies.
  • Review inventory adjustment details in order to research high dollar losses.
  • Complete store research to identify & resolve misdirected freight issues.
    • This includes variance investigations for DC & field related issues.
  • Partner with Federal Authorities in relation to Firearms control and reporting.
Report all findings to database, email contacts and immediate alerts if within criteria.

Safety and Emergency Preparedness

  • Work closely with Operations & Leadership team to investigate incidents which includes document review, visual inspections. Clearly communicate findings with internal & external stakeholders.
  • Serve as support for potentially volatile terminations and /or situations within location.
  • Supports accident investigations with video review and detailed reporting.

Conduct weekly / monthly / quarterly Safety Assessments to ensure overall safety compliance and reports findings.

Physical Security and Investigations

  • Responsible for security screening all people entering/exiting the facility per DSG requirements.
  • Test, troubleshoot and respond to all alarm systems (burglar, Fire & Amarok [perimeter electrified fence])
  • Opening/Closing of DC facility per DSG guidelines without supervision
  • Complete building walkthrough multiple times throughout daily shift
    • Focusing on misdirected freight, safety, physical security, firearm security, & deterrence
  • Knowledge of Genetec system, create access control badges & ensure all building credentials are accurate.
  • Complete daily observations of facility and document /address opportunities.
Conduct and / or support investigations in regard to concerns or violations of the physical security of assigned location and report findings.

Yard Management

  • Assist guard shack as needed with inbound/outbound trailer procedures. Provide physical control of guard shack and perform duties for emergency coverage if / when needed.
  • Resolve daily logs to allow proper YMS (Yard Management System) workflows to be followed.
  • Assist with passive yard control requests.
  • Reconcile Yard Audit results to ensure yard accuracy.
  • Provide direction to 3rd party staff.

Conduct and / or support investigations in to concerns or violations of trailer yard of location and report findings.

Other

  • Conduct Social Engineering Drills with the stores on a regular basis.
  • Assigned schedule can be temporary / permanently changed as needed for the needs of the business.
  • Help maintain inventory of LP Supplies & distribute store orders.
  • Serve as resource/provide guidance to warehouse teammates for a variety of topics.
  • Must be available to be on call during off hours.
  • Must be flexible to cover additional hours to provide support during special projects and facility overtime.
  • Assist in New Hire orientation for Loss Prevention introduction for new Teammates.
  • Support other departments in investigations, presence or as needed. i.e., Human Resources, Operations, Logistics.

Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • 1-3 years experience
  • Loss Prevention, Asset Protection, Profit Protection, Operations, Safety, Logistics
  • Ability to stand, bend, stoop, reach, push, pull and lift 10-50 pounds intermittently.
  • Basic English reading comprehension & numerical reasoning skills.

Virtual Requirements

At DICK’S, we thrive on innovation and authenticity. That said, to protect the integrity and security of our hiring process, we ask that candidates do not use AI tools (like ChatGPT or others) during interviews or assessments.

To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following:

  • Cameras must be on during all virtual interviews.
  • AI tools are not permitted to be used by the candidate during any part of the interview process.
  • Offers are contingent upon a satisfactory background check which may include ID verification.

If you have any questions or need accommodations, we’re here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone!

jobs.description:
Overview

The Loss Prevention Officer ensures the safety and tranquil stay of hotel guests and employees, to enforce the policies and procedures of the hotel and to record in writing any assigned task. Prepare incident and accident reports accurately and in the format specified by the Director of Loss Prevention.

Responsibilities

  • Able to keep accurate records and communicate using radio equipment.
  • Record and report any unsafe conditions while patrolling hotel property.
  • To ensure protection and preservation of hotel, guest, and employee property.
  • Maintain professional attitude and appearance.

Qualifications

  • Previous security experience preferred.
  • Red Cross and First Aid Certified.
  • Able to work nights, weekends, and holidays.

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Security Officer
jobs.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a dedicated Loss Prevention Security Officer to maintain a safe and secure environment for our guests and staff. In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Patrolling all areas of the property and assisting guests with room access.
  • Monitoring Closed Circuit Television, perimeter alarms, duress alarms, and fire life safety systems.
  • Locking property entrances when necessary and conducting daily physical hazard inspections.
  • Responding to accidents, contacting EMS, or administering first aid/CPR as required.
  • Assisting guests and employees during emergency situations and notifying appropriate individuals of incidents.
  • Defusing disturbances and calling for outside assistance if needed.
  • Completing incident reports to document all Security/Loss Prevention related incidents.
  • Handling interruptions and complaints, and resolving safety hazard situations.
  • Escorting unwelcome individuals from the property while ensuring smooth property operations.
  • Reporting to scenes of vehicle accidents or thefts and calling for assistance using proper codes.
  • Completing daily activity reports and maintaining confidentiality of all Security/Loss Prevention documents.
  • Conducting investigations and gathering evidence through interviews with relevant parties.
  • Following all company policies and procedures, reporting accidents and unsafe conditions to management.
  • Ensuring uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional.
  • Welcoming guests and addressing their service needs with genuine appreciation.
  • Developing and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues to reach common goals.
  • Complying with quality assurance expectations.
  • Staying physically active as the role requires standing, walking, or sitting for long periods.

Candidates should be able to move, lift, carry, push, and pull objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance and have the ability to enter and locate work-related information using computers and systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Experience: No previous work experience required.

Licenses/Certifications: None required.

Location: 2222 N Stemmons Fwy, Dallas, Texas, United States, 75207

At Marriott International, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, celebrating diversity and providing access to opportunity for all. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability and veteran status.

If you are passionate about security and creating a safe hospitality experience, we invite you to apply and embark on a rewarding career with us!

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Clerk
jobs.description:
Job Description

California applicants: Please click here to review the Costco Applicant Privacy Notice.

The jobs listed are examples of the typical kinds of positions that Costco may hire for when openings exist. The listing does not mean that any positions are currently open or available at Costco.

Position Summary

Protects company assets from internal and external theft. Reviews individual warehouse inventory numbers and assists in creating / executing a plan of action to reduce shrink. Is familiar with various facets of operation that contribute to shrink and participates in instruction and training with affected employees. Observes and reports potential safety and security hazards. Investigates, detains suspects, completes reports, cooperates with local law enforcement, and testifies in court if necessary. Reports directly to the Warehouse Manager. Provides a high level of member service.

Job Duties

  • Walks the warehouse and perimeter up to 8 hours a day to monitor safety and security concerns. Pushes cart with merchandise and returns items to the floor. Maintains anonymity by shopping amongst members.
  • Follows and maintains knowledge of Costco procedures and applicable laws in performance of duties. Attends meetings and seminars regarding loss prevention.
  • Observes, detects, and investigates internal and external theft threats as well as safety concerns. Retrieves stolen items which shoplifters have concealed; may need to move product to access stolen items.
  • Detains and interviews shoplifters when warranted. Reports potential internal theft situations to the warehouse manager.
  • Prepares reports for internal use and for potential prosecution. Enters cases into case management system Nettrack.
  • Maintains evidence collected and reports files from investigations.
  • Testifies in court concerning theft investigations.
  • Communicates with other area Costco Loss Prevention Clerks and Security people of area businesses to exchange information about current, local theft threats.
  • Ensures proper cleanup and disposal of hazardous materials.
  • Ability to operate vehicles, equipment or machinery.
  • Assists with department duties as necessary.
  • Assists in other departments of the warehouse as necessary.



For additional information about pay ranges, click here.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health benefits - medical/dental/vision/hearing aid/pharmacy/behavioral health/employee assistance, health care reimbursement account, dependent care assistance plan, short-term disability and long-term disability insurance, AD&D insurance, life insurance, 401(k), stock purchase plan to eligible employees.

Apart from any religious or disability considerations, open availability is needed to meet the needs of the business. If hired, you will be required to provide proof of authorization to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Agent
jobs.description:
Loss Prevention Agent

Job Summary:

The primary responsibility of a Loss Prevention Agent & Security Officer at The Westin San Diego Gaslamp Quarter is to ensure the welfare and security of guests, employees, and infrastructure. You will be tasked with conducting regular rounds, attending to urgent situations, monitoring surveillance equipment, and enforcing safety protocols throughout the premises. This role is instrumental in creating a safe and hospitable setting for all patrons.

Benefits:

  • Health care coverage
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Paid leave encompasses both scheduled time off, like vacation days, and unscheduled time off, such as sick days
  • Life and disability insurance serve as crucial safety nets for individuals and their families by providing financial stability during difficult times. These insurance policies can help ease the financial burden that comes with unexpected events, such as illness, injury, or death
  • Wellness programs

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform regular checks in all sections of the property and support guests in gaining room entry.
  • Supervise surveillance cameras, intrusion alerts, and emergency response mechanisms.
  • Reacting to events, such as accidents, crises, and disturbances.
  • Offer primary aid and CPR support while liaising with emergency responders if required.
  • Escort individuals who do not have authorization out of the premises if needed.
  • Create comprehensive documentation of incidents and operational tasks; oversee the upkeep of security registers.
  • Inspect for safety risks and document maintenance concerns.
  • Ensure that doors are locked or unlocked as per the designated timings.
  • Ensure the privacy of reports and confidential data.
  • Offer support for investigations by interviewing relevant parties as necessary.
  • Ensure strict compliance with the company's safety and security protocols.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Educational Qualification: Possession of a high school diploma or a comparable GED qualification.
  • No prior exposure necessary for this position.
  • Licenses or certifications are not obligatory, although state-specific prerequisites might need to be met.
  • Required to lift objects weighing up to 50 pounds and demonstrate agility during unexpected events.
  • Proficient in communicating clearly through both spoken and written language.
  • Maintaining a sense of tranquility when faced with pressure and managing conflicts in a mature manner.

About Us:

We at Westin, which is under the umbrella of Marriott International, are devoted to supporting our guests and staff to reach their maximum potential. Our ethos revolves around promoting well-being, inclusivity, and opportunities for all. Join us as we strive to build a stable and nurturing environment where both guests and team members can prosper.

Job Number26099779

Location2222 N Stemmons Fwy, Dallas, Texas, United States, 75207VIEW ON MAP
ScheduleFull Time
Located Remotely?N
Position Type Non-Management
Pay Range: $20.50-$21.00 per hour

POSITION SUMMARY

Patrol all areas of the property; assist guests with room access. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions, perimeter alarm system, duress alarms, and fire life safety system. Lock property entrances when required. Conduct daily physical hazard inspections. Respond to accidents, contact EMS or administer first aid/CPR as required. Assist guests/employees during emergency situations. Notify appropriate individuals in the event of accidents, attacks, or other incidents. Defuse guest/employee disturbances. Call for outside assistance if necessary. Complete incident reports to document all Security/Loss Prevention related incidents. Handle all interruptions and complaints. Resolve safety hazard situations. Escort any unwelcome persons from the property without interrupting the orderly flow of property operation. Report to scenes of vehicle accidents/thefts. Call for assistance using proper code responses. Complete a Loss Prevention shift summary/daily activity report. Maintain confidentiality of all Security/Loss Prevention and property reports/documents; release information only to authorized individuals. Conduct investigations and gather evidence. Conduct interviews with relevant parties.

Follow all company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. In addition, some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (e.g., run, walk, jog). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At Renaissance Hotels, we believe in helping our guests experience the DNA of the neighborhoods they are visiting. Our guests come to discover and uncover the unexpected, to dive into a new culture, or simply to make the most of a free evening. They see business travel as an adventure because they see all travel as an adventure. Where others may settle for the usual, our guests see a chance to bring home a great story. And so do we. We’re looking for fellow spontaneous explorers to join our team to bring the spirit of the neighborhood to our guests. If this sounds like you, we invite you to discover career opportunities with Renaissance Hotels. In joining Renaissance Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.
